brand_dna.category: UK direct-to-consumer gourmet brownie brand selling handmade gift boxes of stuffed, flavour-led brownies (BWOWNIES).
brand_dna.core_belief: These aren't brownies at all... they're BWOWNIES! (Brownies with a WOW) - a founder-built brand out to prove people wrong and become a household name.
proof_points: Handmade in Suffolk, freshly baked every day
Last up to 10 days in the fridge and up to 2 months in the freezer
brand_dna.positioning: Premium, playful gifting treat - loud and cheeky rather than minimal, sold as an experience not just a snack.

voice_pillars.name: Cheeky and Playful
voice_pillars.desc: Copy is casual, tongue-in-cheek, and never takes itself too seriously.
voice_pillars.quote: STOP LOOKING AT MY BOTTOM, THE BWOWNIES ARE FURTHER UP!

voice_pillars.name: Indulgently Over-the-Top
voice_pillars.desc: Leans hard into rich, decadent language to make treats feel irresistible.
voice_pillars.quote: The OG. Deep, rich and ridiculously fudgy.

voice_pillars.name: Founder-Personal
voice_pillars.desc: Writes in first person like a real person talking to you, sharing favourites and behind-the-scenes.
voice_pillars.quote: I genuinely cannot stop eating them, so I am going to need your help

voice_pillars.name: Underdog Story-Driven
voice_pillars.desc: Frames the brand around beating the odds and proving doubters wrong.
voice_pillars.quote: Despite being told he would never make it Keelan proved them wrong.

icp: UK sweet-toothed treat lovers and gift buyers who want a premium, indulgent handmade brownie box that feels fun and personal, and who happily pay more for quality and a bit of wow.

personas.name: The Gift Sender
personas.description: Buys a gift-ready box to surprise friends or family - moved by premium packaging, handwritten touches and the shareable moment.

personas.name: The Sweet Indulger
personas.description: Treats themselves to something rich and gooey - moved by decadent flavour descriptions and dangerously addictive stuffed centres.

personas.name: The Flavour Explorer
personas.description: Loves trying new and nostalgic flavours like Oreo, Biscoff and Reese's - moved by new drops and taster boxes to sample the range.

offers: Free shipping nationwide when you spend GBP 34.99
ULTIMATE BWOWNIES BUNDLE at GBP 52.99 (mix of best flavours)
Gift cards from GBP 10 to GBP 100
Gift-ready packaging with option to send as a gift

allowed.claim: Last up to 10 days in the fridge and up to 2 months in the freezer

banned.claim: The BEST brownie brand in the world
banned.why: FTC/ASA - unqualified superlative that cannot be substantiated (currently stated on about page and must not be used in ads).

banned.claim: Best Seller / Bestseller labels without data
banned.why: Must be backed by actual sales evidence or it is an unsubstantiated objective claim.
FTC Green Guides - unqualified environmental claim with no stated proof or certification.

banned.claim: Guaranteed to be everyone's favourite / you will love them
banned.why: Guaranteed-results claim not provable and not typical for all customers.

banned.claim: Cherry-picked quotes like 'best brownies I have ever tried in my 41 years' as typical
banned.why: Testimonials must reflect typical results, not outlier reviews.

banned.claim: Fake urgency such as 'only hours left' or invented stock timers
banned.why: Fake urgency is banned; only genuine, accurate stock or time claims allowed.
